title: Stage signed native-memory executable v0.2.3 candidate
body:
This PR stages the first self-hosted Aimee native-memory executable for a GitHub Release from `RakuenSoftware/aimee`, targeting **`testing`**. Its private implementation is in [aimee-qwen PR #3](https://github.com/RakuenSoftware/aimee-qwen/pull/3). This public PR commits signed metadata, verification code, release notes, and the draft-release procedure; compiled wheels and signatures remain staged as release attachments.

The final GLIBC 2.34-compatible wheel SHA-256 is `b4b9d7fe7249bf304cadabbfea0bde53bcdd84d8f7186e3a9aa74180f9380736` (3,526,478 bytes). Manifest SHA-256 is `7fc6eed5eb09e9de856e92ca927b439f90a7b53be911b2f84531a82c0b4e2977`. The exact eight assets are staged at `/opt/aimee-native-release/public-staging/native-memory-v0.2.3-r15-final` on CT101. All hashes and four Ed25519 signatures verify. Wheel integrity, binary-disclosure audit, `pip check`, and actual GLIBC 2.34 container execution pass. The private audit rejects binaries above the declared GLIBC floor.

The exact installed final wheel passed live enrolled release-path checks on RTX 5080 / Gemma4 12B Q8, 2 × RX 7900 XTX / Gemma4 26B Q8, and 2 × RX 7900 XTX / Qwen3.8 27B Q8. Each answered two selected native-memory facts from one bank (34, 34, and 29 prompt tokens respectively) and denied the next request with HTTP 503 after revocation. Those selected-record tests used a local mTLS primitive fixture with a standard thin-client profile. Separately, a fresh `aimee:testing` server enrolled a real thin client: the exact wheel connected, fetched the native primitive, and received HTTP 401 for an invalid bearer. That fresh account had no write-tier grant, so its response contained zero records.

The stage is signed but **not published**. Public Aimee v0.4.6 predates `/v1/native/primitive`; the latest application release must include the route from merged PR #3001 before plugin publication. [Draft promotion PR #3003](https://github.com/RakuenSoftware/aimee/pull/3003) prepares that application release. After review and merge, `create_draft_release.sh` attaches the eight exact assets to a draft prerelease. Public download and clean external installation remain publication checks.
head: release/native-memory-v0.2.3
